evidence.quote: rollback rehearsals run monthly from now on

observations.why: Establishing a recurring cadence appeals to stability/security (conservation) and ensures the team maintains the capability to execute rollbacks (competence).

evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have

observations.why: The aphoristic equivalence frames unrehearsed capability as no capability at all, appealing to competence as the value under threat.
Restating the cadence as a fixed label appeals to conservation — institutionalizing a recurring practice for stability.
Naming an owner assigns self-origination of the rehearsal program, appealing to autonomy as the good of owning the process.
